evidence.title: Does This Video Show Male Congress Worker Attacking Woman Cop During Anti-CEC Protest In Delhi?

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing the Assam chief minister threatening members of the Cockroach Janata Party, saying they would be kicked out.
claims.explanation: Keyword searches led Newschecker to the same footage on News24 and Republic Bharat channels and in an ANI post, all from April 2026, months before the claim spread. The longer versions show the chief minister speaking at an election rally in Baguiati, West Bengal, where his remark was aimed at infiltrators and Bangladeshi Muslims, not at the party whose volunteers had just been detained in Assam.
claims.why_misleading: The footage and the words are genuine, but they come from a five-month-old rally in another state about a different group of people, so the clip documents no threat to the protesters who were detained.

evidence.title: ‘Will Kick Them Out’: Does Viral Video Show Assam CM Threatening CJP Protesters?

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing men harassing an elderly disabled Muslim man in India and overturning his wheelchair.
claims.explanation: A reverse image search of keyframes took Newschecker to a YouTube channel that uploaded the same footage in December 2025 and states in its bio that its videos are scripted and planned for entertainment. Other uploads on that channel feature the same elderly man in different staged scenes, including standing and selling eggs, showing the harassment was performed by the same group.

evidence.title: Scripted Video Shared As Showing Elderly Disabled Muslim Man Being Harassed In India

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing Congress MP Shashi Tharoor saying in an interview that the Mecca pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey is a threat to India.
claims.explanation: Newschecker traced the clip's Al Arabiya English watermark to the full September 2020 interview, where Tharoor said the opposite: it was premature to raise alarm over the declaration and he saw no direct threat from the alliance. Keyword searches found no credible report of the quoted remark, the lip area in the viral clip looks distorted, and two audio tools, the Hiya deepfake detector and Resemble AI, classified the voice as AI-generated. Tharoor himself reposted a correction.

evidence.title: Video Claiming To Show Shashi Tharoor Calling Mecca Pact A Threat To India Is Altered

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu telling the UN General Assembly that America deserved 9/11.
claims.explanation: A reverse image search of keyframes led Newschecker to the UN's own YouTube channel carrying the full General Debate address. At the 27-minute mark the line is introduced as something said by a US political commentator whose views Netanyahu was citing while criticising New York's mayor, and the Israeli government's published transcript of the speech reflects the same sequence.
claims.why_misleading: The footage and the audio are authentic, but the clip starts mid-sentence and cuts out the words identifying another person as the source of the remark, turning a quotation into an apparent statement of Netanyahu's own view.

evidence.title: Did Benjamin Netanyahu Say ‘America Deserved 9/11’? No, Clipped Video Goes Viral

claims.claim: A video of a girl crying is shared as showing the student who was allegedly assaulted in Bihar's Jamui district in September 2026.
claims.explanation: A reverse image search of keyframes traced the footage to an Instagram account that posted it in November 2025, ten months before the Jamui case, with the girl saying she is from Meghalaya and alleging that two boys had made an objectionable video of her using AI. Jamui Police replied publicly to a post carrying the clip, stating the girl is not the survivor and asking people not to circulate unverified material that could expose someone's identity.

evidence.title: Jamui Molestation Case: No, This Video Does Not Show Survivor

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni at a UN event with a Palestinian flag over her shoulder while walking past Benjamin Netanyahu without acknowledging him.
claims.explanation: Newschecker found no credible report of such an appearance and followed the clip's watermark to a TikTok account that first posted it in April 2026 along with other Meloni-themed videos, some explicitly labelled AI-generated. The UN logo in the backdrop is distorted, and four detection tools, Undetectable AI, WasItAI, IsItAI and Sightengine, flagged the footage and its extracted frames as likely machine-generated.

evidence.title: AI-Generated Video Falsely Shows Giorgia Meloni Carrying Palestinian Flag At UN Event

claims.claim: Two videos are shared as showing police parading men accused in the September 2026 assault case in Bihar's Jamui district.
claims.explanation: Reverse image searches placed the first clip with December 2025 social posts and Dainik Bhaskar and Amar Ujala reports about a police procession in Khachrod, Ujjain district, Madhya Pradesh. The second matched July 2026 posts and reports by News18 and Dainik Bhaskar about arrested men being paraded in Alirajpur district, also in Madhya Pradesh, after a case registered with the Bori police station.

evidence.title: Old, Unrelated Videos From Madhya Pradesh Shared As Police Parading Accused In Jamui Molestation Case

claims.claim: A screengrab is shared as leaked CCTV footage from the investigation into actor Sushant Singh Rajput's 2020 death, showing two other prominent film actors nearby.
claims.explanation: Newschecker found no credible report of CCTV footage recovered from the actor's home, and India Today and Times of India had reported in July 2020 that police said no cameras were installed inside the residence. Reverse image searches plus Google AI and Meta AI labelled the screenshot fake, and the Deepfakes Analysis Unit's checks with AIorNot and Image Whisperer flagged it as likely AI-generated, pointing to distorted facial features and a staged composition that no real camera angle would produce.

evidence.title: Sushant Singh Rajput Death Case: AI-Generated Image Falsely Shared As Leaked CCTV Screengrab

claims.claim: A video is shared as a BJP MLA's reaction to the September 2026 Jamui assault case in Bihar, in which she says women are safe in the state.
claims.explanation: A reverse image search led Newschecker to a longer version published by The Indian Express in April 2026 and to an ANI upload of the same interaction, in which the MLA was answering another politician's remarks about women's safety in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. Keyword searches found no report tying the statement to the Jamui case, and the MLA had separately posted that she found the incident reprehensible and shameful.
claims.why_misleading: The statement is real but was made five months earlier about a different political argument. Reusing it as her response to the Jamui case suggests she dismissed an incident she had in fact condemned, and hides that the assurance referred to a general debate on women's safety.

evidence.title: ‘Women Are Safe In Bihar’: Old Video Of BJP MLA Maithili Thakur Shared As Her Reaction To Jamui Molestation Case

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing a man harassing a street vendor at Patna Junction, flipping his snacks tray and pushing him.
claims.explanation: Reverse image searches of keyframes led Newschecker to posts by the content creator who made the clip, on Facebook and Instagram in September, in which the men say the video was scripted for entertainment and ask viewers not to share it as real. Other videos on the same accounts show the two men repeatedly acting out staged scenarios together.

evidence.title: Viral Video Of Man Harassing Street Vendor At Patna Junction Is Scripted

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing the 136-year-old Gauripur Jama Masjid near Kolkata airport being destroyed by religious extremists to make way for a temple.

Keyword searches produced no report of any vandalism at the mosque near Kolkata airport, which BBC Bangla had reported in July 2026 had stopped prayers and was to be relocated.

A stock-image listing of the same Changsha building and several other 2022 news reports confirmed the origin.

evidence.title: West Asia Crisis: Old Video From China Falsely Shared As US Attack On IRGC Facility In Tehran

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing a massive fire in Russia caused by a recent Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow and the surrounding region.
claims.explanation: Newschecker concluded the footage has no link to the Russia-Ukraine conflict and actually shows a large commercial fire in the Talbiya area of Faisal, Giza, in Egypt. The outlet noted the same clip had earlier circulated with another false claim, that it showed the aftermath of an Iranian strike on Israel, which it had already debunked in July 2026.

evidence.title: Old Video From Egypt Falsely Linked To Recent Ukrainian Drone Attack On Russia

claims.claim: A video is shared as showing a recent car rally held in support of a man arrested in the Gurugram hit-and-run case.
claims.explanation: Reverse image searches found the same footage in Instagram posts from April and May 2025, well before the hit-and-run case, one of them carrying hashtags about a film with a thumbnail of people at a cinema.
